bettermoving.gui.title: BetterMoving Configuration
bettermoving.config.comment.model: Choose how water is treated in movement calculations.
bettermoving.config.comment.virtualPlatf: Create an invisible client-side platform beneath your feet.
bettermoving.config.comment.voidProtecti: Create a virtual platform at the void damage Y boundary, similar to Virtual platform.
bettermoving.config.comment.ignoreSprint: Allow sprinting at food level 6 or below.
bettermoving.config.comment.customRiptid: When enabled, adjust the trident's charge duration using Riptide charge time (ticks).
bettermoving.config.comment.riptideCharg: Minimum charge duration for simulated Riptide, in ticks. Requires both Simulate Riptide anywhere and Custom Riptide charge time. Defaults to 10; accepts 0 to Integer.MAX_VALUE ticks. At 0, releasing immediately launches the player.
bettermoving.config.comment.overridePoti: Choose whether simulated potion effects override existing effects. When disabled, use the stronger effect, following vanilla behavior.
bettermoving.config.comment.ignoreLevita: Ignore the movement effects of Levitation and Slowness.
bettermoving.config.comment.hoverWhenEly: While Elytra gliding without an active attached firework or Riptide spin, immediately clear XYZ velocity and hover in place. Keep the glide active and resume movement during propulsion.
bettermoving.config.name.cancelElytraFir: Cancel Elytra fireworks on glide stop
bettermoving.config.comment.cancelElytra: When enabled together with Infinite fireworks, immediately remove client-simulated firework rockets when the local player stops gliding instead of keeping them until their lifetime ends.
bettermoving.config.comment.elytraFirewo: Prevent launching free-flying fireworks while gliding.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulateElyt: When enabled for the local player, adjust Elytra firework acceleration toward the configured target speed. The target is expressed in meters per second and converted to meters per tick using V / 20.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulatedSpe: Use this Speed potion level for horizontal movement when Simulate potion effects is enabled. Level 0 adds no effect; level 1 matches Speed I. Existing stronger Speed effects are preserved. Values range from 0 to Integer.MAX_VALUE.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulatedJum: Use this Jump Boost potion level for jumping when Simulate potion effects is enabled. Level 0 adds no effect; level 1 matches Jump Boost I. Existing stronger Jump Boost effects are preserved. Values range from 0 to Integer.MAX_VALUE.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulatedDol: Use this Dolphin's Grace effect level for water movement when Simulate potion effects is enabled. Level 0 adds no effect; any positive integer matches the vanilla Dolphin's Grace movement behavior. Existing Dolphin's Grace is preserved unless Override existing potion effects is enabled. Values range from 0 to Integer.MAX_VALUE.
bettermoving.config.comment.simulatedEly: Target equilibrium speed for local Elytra firework acceleration when Simulate Elytra firework target speed is enabled. The value is in meters per second, accepts 0 to Double.MAX_VALUE, and defaults to 64 (3.2 meters per tick).
bettermoving.config.comment.customElytra: When enabled, replace the vanilla flight duration of Elytra firework rockets for Flight 1, 2, and 3 using the values below. Other Flight values remain unchanged.
bettermoving.config.comment.elytraFirewo: Custom lifetime in ticks for Flight 1 firework rockets. Applied only while Custom Elytra firework lifetime is enabled. Values range from 0 to Integer.MAX_VALUE ticks.
Custom lifetime in ticks for Flight 2 firework rockets. Applied only while Custom Elytra firework lifetime is enabled. Values range from 0 to Integer.MAX_VALUE ticks.
Custom lifetime in ticks for Flight 3 firework rockets. Applied only while Custom Elytra firework lifetime is enabled. Values range from 0 to Integer.MAX_VALUE ticks.
bettermoving.config.comment.resetMomentu: Press to clear the local player's X, Y, and Z velocity once.
bettermoving.config.comment.openConfigGu: Open the BetterMoving MaLiLib configuration screen.
